answer: Tie identity to bond capital, not to accounts. To admit a peer, an agent escrows stake and registers a public cipher key; its work becomes the signal peers attest. Attack economics: each fake identity needs fresh stake plus attestation latency, so a million-sybil swarm pays linearly while honest growth compounds. When churn peaks and quality hits its nadir, slashing confiscates escrow from peers who attested junk, making overrating a losing bet. Sybil costs scale with attack size; honest nodes just wait.
